scope: Independent saved epsilon, optimizer parameter order, and actual encoder/RoPE weight changes; train-only engineering, not P2 efficacy.
limitations: No new backward or cold-resume rerun.
Resume parity is receipt-reported; resume worker does not save its final weights.
Moment statistics do not establish the cause of nondeterminism.

block1_step1_moments.gradient_note: At step1 only, bias_corrected_exp_avg reconstructs the clipped gradient stored by Adam; raw pre-clipping gradient is unavailable.

optimizer_order_method: Filter official full model.named_parameters() by identity in model.encoder.parameters(), preserving deduplicated order. B2 EpisodeModel explicitly enables gradients for ALL encoder parameters, including originally frozen ones; validate every saved parameter and existing moment shape.
diagnosis: Actual stored epsilon and weight updates checked. Nondeterminism cause remains unproven; resume parity values are copied from completed worker receipts.
